title: FastPath changelog edit sprints and ops handback
creator: Morgan Lee
description:
Goal: Create a repeatable, low-latency process for drafting customer-facing change digests and an internal annotated change capsule, then hand the operational artifacts back to Support/EngOps for post-launch monitoring and playbooks.

Scope:
- Two-track outputs: 1) concise customer-facing delta (one-paragraph + bulletized impact) and 2) internal annotated capsule (detailed notes, risks, rollback, metrics to watch).
- A 3-day FastPath edit sprint model for minor releases and a 10-day path for major updates.
- Asynchronous signoff flow (Slack + Google Form) with time-bound escalation to PM/EM on the final day.
- Template artifacts (Confluence page, Google Drive doc, one-click GitHub PR snippet) and starter copy localized for NA/EU/APAC.

Acceptance criteria:
- Templates stored under Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/FastPath+Changelog+Template
- A Slack workflow that collects signoffs within 48 hours and posts a summary to #release-signoff.
- A draft customer digest and annotated capsule exists for the next minor release at least 72 hours before release window.
- Ops handback checklist created and owned by EngOps with playbook links and Datadog dashboards.

Deliverables:
- FastPath changelog template (customer + internal)
- Slack signoff workflow + Google form to capture approvals and redaction notes
- Reviewer matrix (who approves which section: PM/Design/Legal/Privacy/Security/Support)
- Ops handback checklist and minimal runbook (Datadog/Logs/Incident playbook snippets)

Stakeholders:
- Product: Morgan Lee (creator), Elena Garcia (assignee)
- Eng: Priya Raman (runtime), Theo Park (infra)
- Design: Samira Khan (copy review)
- Legal & Privacy: Fiona Zhou
- EngOps/Support: Mateo Ruiz

Risks & tradeoffs:
- Fast edit sprints increase risk of missing a privacy/legal flag; mitigated via mandatory Legal quick-scan and redaction notes in the form.
- Localized copy may lag; strategy is to include an English canonical digest plus a localized note for major markets.

How this ties to other work:
- Reuses the release digest taxonomy being piloted in PM-4127 and dovetails with rollout gating in ENG-1842.

Links & artifacts:
- Draft template (Drive): https://drive.google.com/fastpath-changelog-template
- Example GitHub PR with auto-snippet: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1234
- Datadog dashboard to watch: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/abcd-release-metrics
